sections.content: Use *porque* to give a reason and por *eso* to introduce a consequence. The two connectors can appear in the same exchange or sequence of sentences.

items.spanish: Ha llovido porque ha cambiado el tiempo.
items.english: It has rained because the weather has changed.

items.spanish: Ha llovido, por eso hemos cambiado la ruta.
items.english: It has rained, so we have changed the route.

items.spanish: Hemos vuelto porque nos hemos mojado.
items.english: We have returned because we have got wet.

items.spanish: Nos hemos mojado, por eso hemos vuelto.
items.english: We have got wet, so we have returned.

sections.content: Use *porque* to answer 'why?' and por *eso* to show a consequence.
